Record Class OpenAIChatCompletionBody

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
library.models.json.OpenAIChatCompletionBody
public record OpenAIChatCompletionBody(String model, List<OpenAIChatCompletionBody.Message> messages, @Nullable Double temperature, @Nullable Integer maxTokens, @Nullable Boolean stream) extends Record
Represents the body of a request sent to the OpenAI Chat Completion API. This record encapsulates information about the model, a list of messages for the prompt, temperature for randomness, a limit on maximum tokens, and whether to stream the result.
